# Subway Seat for Procreate

A Procreate palette per flavor with all 26 colors in role order: grounds, text, then accents. Procreate palettes don't carry swatch names.

[Procreate](https://procreate.com) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/procreate/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in your iPad:

```text
Open Subway Seat.swatches from Files or AirDrop; it lands in Colors › Palettes.
```
